draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.33, the 48th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 4th of 18 at S. He lasted until pick 96, well after his grade rank (48th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Malik Hooker. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile). College production: 83 tackles in 2024, 4th of 18 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 17 career games and 17 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 7 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: interceptions 5 (98th percentile), passes defended 11 (95th percentile), season snap share 99.1% (95th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 safety who played: 99.1% season snap share against a median of 24.1%, above the norm.
